title.narrative: The Miisaan: Social Cohesion & Legitimate Governance Through Transitional Justice

description.narrative: It is a four-year programme (2021-2025), which specifically aims at increasing the availability of inclusively developed and locally informed transitional justice processes in Somaliland that significantly contribute to existing efforts on social cohesion and governance. The Transitional Justice Programme will be implemented by a Consortium comprised of Interpeace, the lead Agency, in partnership with Berghof Foundation and MediaINK.

The Miisaan Programme: Social Cohesion and Legitimate Governance through Transitional Justice (2021–2025)1 was conceptualised with the overall goal of contributing towards increasing the availability of inclusively developed and locally informed transitional justice processes in Somalia and Somaliland. The programme was implemented by Interpeace in partnership with Media INK, IPCS-Hargeisa University, and affiliate partners.

A national media campaign is conducted to highlight the transitional justice concerns raised during community consultations, including those with women and youth, and priorities selected to be included in a transitional justice process.
